field_principles.field_principles: Explain fields without wrapping numeric gates or ordinary dictionaries.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: Preserve critical verifier findings and never use invalid science for readiness.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked result names upstream path, check, field, expected value, and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ for finished work and blocked_ for an unchanged missing prerequisite.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe current work with a string and keep device and software facts in details.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use model_bounded_generation for these fixed short outputs and never pad runtime.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Derive current owned load and generation dispositions from events, never historical evidence.
field_principles.model_invoked: Set true for an attempted current real model load or generation, including failure.
field_principles.owned_runtime_receipt: Bind current PID, start tick, GGUF hash, CUDA offload, and resource ownership evidence.
field_principles.phase_spans: Retain actual phase boundaries, heartbeat checkpoints, and completed units.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Authenticate exact inputs, eligibility, cache, runner, device, and entrypoint before dependent work.
field_principles.promotion_score: Keep zero; the canary cannot roll out, update weights, publish, or submit externally.
field_principles.qwen_assignment_transport_ready_score: Require at least three usable fresh proposals plus sound evidence and validation.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze experiment and resampling seeds before observing outputs.
field_principles.repository_health: Keep unrelated broad-suite observations separate while affected failures remain disqualifying.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind current code, settings, inputs, protocol, events, and raw rows.
field_principles.rows: Keep every call, condition, metric contribution, cost, failure, and censoring disposition.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260918 and preserve actual UTC start and completion timestamps.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Predeclare planned, attempted, completed, censored, unstarted, limits, stop rule, and independent groups.
field_principles.schema: Use a versioned schema and ordinary identity fields; publish terminal state only after measured work and checks.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hash exact producer, code, model, runner, sidecar, and raw evidence bytes.
field_principles.transport_rows: Retain all four request hashes, budgets, source literals, parse, fidelity, extendibility, and cost fields.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain exact argv, scoped environment, check name, exit, duration, and hashed log, including failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use only positive, circular_positive, null, blocked, disqualified, or partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Mark true because exact SAT evaluation defines correctness; transport remains a separate metric.
